ModMetaData.name: Carry Capacity from Bionics
ModMetaData.author: VitaKaninen
ModMetaData.description:
[h2]Description[/h2] Adds Extra pawn inventory and caravan carrying capacity from Bionics.
This is intended to be used with mods such as "Pick Up and Haul" and "While You're Up", that utilize the player's inventory for hauling around the map.
Also includes optional settings to reduce carry capacity if a pawn has missing or injured body parts.
[h2]FAQ[/h2] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3564369362]Q:[/url] What are the values you used for each bionic, and how did you arrive at that number? [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3564369362]A:[/url] Here is a spreadsheet with all the bionics and their values, and the method I used. [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1k_BQcZxK3mnv6ZPR2nTX4FIXxrspoflj-XeAvqf1gKI/edit?usp=sharing]Carry Capacity from Bionics[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3564369362]Q:[/url] What if I don't like the values you chose? [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3564369362]A:[/url] The mod comes with settings for each body part, and you can enable or disable anything you like, or adjust the settings to your liking.
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3564369362]Q:[/url] Can I add it to an existing save? [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3564369362]A:[/url] Yes, it can be safely added or removed at any time.
